title: Checkbox list
description: A list of options to tick, in three styles. The checkbox icon morphs into a tick when you select it.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: A checkbox with an icon for a tick
fragments.note: The input stays; the icon is what you see. It follows data-checked on the label.

fragments.title: Mirror checked into an attribute
fragments.note: A few lines let the icon follow a native checkbox.

fragments.title: Resting, hovered, chosen
fragments.note: Plain CSS rules; the icon inherits colour. No transition.
